shadows.name: tooltip
shadows.purpose: Separate transient values from the ledger.

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-button { font: inherit; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tool selector
components.css: .ds-select { font: inherit; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-select:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Summary card
components.description: Metric with context, not a billing claim.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Estimate warning
components.css: .ds-warning { border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--warning); }

components.name: Tooltip
components.css: .ds-tooltip { max-width: 360px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid #71849c; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text); background: #253145; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: The user brief fixes a restrained dark developer tool. Show data and its limits without decorative branding. Preserve familiar native controls and clear state.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, readable data with tabular numbers.
Flat slate regions and consistent rules.
Names and values accompany chart colors.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Never use color alone to identify a tool or model.

dos: Do keep exact model/tool names available and safely rendered as text.
Do retain contrast and keyboard access across refresh and empty states.
donts: Don't style estimates as authoritative bills.
Don't add marketing sections, remote fonts, animation, or new filters.
